caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular green panel positioned vertically in the center of a plain, off-white background. On the panel, there is a relief design showing a branching plant with stems, leaves, and flowers. The stems are slender and twisting, extending diagonally across the panel. Several clusters of elliptical, green leaves with visible veins are attached to the stems. Interspersed among the leaves are flower buds and three fully open, stylized flowers with rounded petals arranged in concentric layers, each flower outlined distinctively. The entire plant and flower motif is rendered in varying shades of green and outlined with brown, while the background of the panel is a darker green, contrasting with the lighter hues of the leaves and flowers. The edges of the green panel are straight, and the rest of the composition is unadorned, focusing all attention on the vertical botanical design.
title: Carved Wood Panel
